verdict.rationale: Skyfire's docs say all issued tokens conform to the open KYAPay protocol, an industry specification published at KYAPay.org, so the token and credential format is openly specified. However, charging, wallets and settlement run only through Skyfire's own key-gated APIs, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec for those APIs. Missing for 10: evidence the KYAPay spec is versioned, evidence it can be implemented without signing any agreement or license, an open spec for the charge/settlement layer, and independent corroboration of someone implementing the spec.
